notes: `guard fm.fileExists(atPath: slotsDir.path) else { return [] }` (line 280) short-circuits before any directory read is attempted. This is the ordinary case for any server that has never been stopped inside MSC 1 -- world_slots/ is only created lazily by createInitialWorldSlotIfNeeded after first stop -- so an empty result here must not be treated as an error condition upstream.
